question_cn: 双兵突破（兵的牺牲换取通路）的核心逻辑是：
question_en: Pawn breakthrough (sacrifice one pawn to create a passer) — the core logic is:

options.text_cn: 牺牲一个兵，迫使对方王或兵暴露，让另一个兵成为通路兵
options.text_en: Sacrifice one pawn to force enemy king or pawn to expose, creating a passed pawn

options.text_cn: 同时推进两个兵，让对方无法阻挡
options.text_en: Push both pawns at the same time so opponent can't block

options.text_cn: 先吃掉对方所有兵再推进
options.text_en: Capture all enemy pawns first, then advance

explanation_cn: 联兵突破是兵残局高级技巧：一个兵牺牲充当诱饵，迫使对方兵或王去吃，另一个兵变成自由通路兵。这是以"兵换通路"的战略交换思维。
explanation_en: Advanced technique: one pawn sacrifices as a decoy, forcing the enemy pawn or king to capture, turning the other pawn into a free passer — trading material for a passed pawn.
